item.title: U.S. science agency moves to restrict foreign scientists from its labs
Microsoft bans the word "Microslop" on its Discord, then locks the server
item.description:
📝 Windows Latest was first to notice that the word “Microslop” was actively filtered in the official Microsoft Copilot Discord server. Windows Latest found that sending a message with the word “Microslop” inside the official Copilot Discord server immediately triggers an automated moderation response. Shortly after Windows Latest posted about Copilot Discord server blocking Microslop on X, users began experimenting in the server with variations such as “Microsl0p” using a zero instead of the letter “o.
🔗 Read more: https://www.windowslatest.com/2026/03/02/microsoft-gets-tired-of-microslop-bans-the-word-on-its-discord-then-locks-the-server-after-backlash/
